text: No tree-cover loss of 0.5 hectares or larger was detected on the asset after 2020. The evidence covers the period from 2021 to 2025 and is based on satellite data with 30-meter resolution. However, smaller changes (under 0.5 ha) or losses at the edges of the asset might not be visible due to the pixel size. The forest cover in 2020 was 43.3 hectares, or 11.55% of the asset. This assessment does not confirm whether *any* tree loss occurred—only that no significant losses were detected.
